content: Inter, Geist, and IBM Plex Sans are all self-hostable variable fonts via Fontsource (all at v5.3.0 in the @fontsource-variable scope, verified npm 2026-07-20). Geist (Vercel) targets developer-tool/infra-SaaS aesthetics and ships a matching Geist Mono; reported to feel cramped at small (14px) sizes under Windows ClearType. Inter is the safest, most battle-tested UI-density choice, optimized for small sizes and dense data tables. IBM Plex Sans carries a more 'engineering/enterprise' character; pairs with IBM Plex Mono.
